blocks.text: 7.4 Rate law, rate constant aur reaction ka order

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke neeche foran 7.4.1 shuru karti hai. Is hisse mein chaar baatein hain: rate law aur rate constant (7.4.1), reaction ka order (7.4.2), order ki qismein (7.4.3), aur rate constant ki units (7.4.4). Khulasa: reaction ki rate reactants ki concentrations par depend karti hai, aur yeh taalluq ek equation (rate law) se likha jata hai jis ki powers tajurbe (experiment) se milti hain.

blocks.prompt: Reaction ka order us ki balanced equation se kyun nahi parha ja sakta?
blocks.explanation: Balanced equation sirf yeh batati hai ke kitne moles react karte aur bante hain. Rate is par depend karti hai ke reaction asal mein kin qadmon (mechanism) se hoti hai, khaas taur par sab se sust qadam par. Is liye rate law ki powers tajurbe se maloom karni parti hain; yeh coefficients ke barabar ho bhi sakti hain aur nahi bhi.

items: Rate law rate ko concentrations se jorta hai; k rate constant hai aur powers ka majmooa (sum) order hai (tafseel 7.4.1 se 7.4.4 mein).
